library.title: Record vaccination programme activity
library.intro: Record what a vaccination programme did in an area and period: sessions planned and held, doses administered and supply received and used. Counts only: never a person vaccinated, a name, an identifier or anything about an individual. Say which counts are estimated or incomplete; a missing count is never read as zero. Small numbers are protected before anything is published, by the rule the nation sets.
library.filled_by: A licensed facility or programme site the programme authorises, online, at an office or on paper.

values.label: Partial: some sources have not reported

nation_values.decision: The reporting deadline of each programme.
The count below which a cell is suppressed before publication or exchange.

deviations.what: Programme-level aggregates only: sessions planned and held, doses administered and supply received and used, by area and period; no vaccination record of a person, no case, suspected or confirmed case, individual report or determination
deviations.why: Approved aggregate public-health statistics and programme administration are in scope; individual vaccination records (HLT-PH-012) and adverse-event reports about a person (HLT-PH-013) are not.
deviations.rule: Owner's direction 2026-10-21 §1; CLAUDE.md Health: returns are aggregates; docs/requirements/form-scope.json HLT-PH-012, HLT-PH-013

deviations.what: "Eligible programme activity recorded" is recorded for the programme, never for a person: no vaccinee, no eligibility check of an individual, no dose given to a named person; eligibility is the programme's, cited from the nation's law when the programme is established (public-health.programme)
deviations.why: A vaccination record about a person is excluded by the approved scope; the eligibility the catalogue names is a term of the programme.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Health: no patient or clinical field anywhere, no national patient record; owner's direction 2026-10-21 §1 (HLT-PH-012 excluded)

deviations.what: Supply is counted for the programme's own supply items (a product of the register of medicines and medical devices with its unit): received and used in the period. Lot, expiry, location and stock transactions are a logistics system the platform does not hold
deviations.why: The specification's supply-item record needs inventory feeds that do not exist; the programme-level count is what is in scope.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Integration register (logistics and inventory: docs/INTEGRATION_REGISTER.md); Institutional specification Part 2 §C.2 national-twin indicator "where reliable inventory feeds exist"

deviations.what: Passing aggregates to the statistics service is an exchange the nation approves (CFG-HX-001); none ships
deviations.why: Exchange services answer only for an approved purpose.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Government operating model: exchange services (callService())

deviations.what: Owner: the public-health authority slot (publicHealth), which ships empty: until the nation names it, the health regulator slot (healthRegulation) stands in as a provisional owner (lib/nation/deployment.ts provisionalOwner()), never proof of legal competence
deviations.why: Authority comes only from the deployment profile; the nation names its public-health authority there, or the health regulator where its law gives it the returns (integration register 20.8, 20.14).
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Government operating model: authorityFor(), never a ministry by name

deviations.what: Patient consent, emergency clinical access and a shared patient reference do not arise: the form carries no patient, clinical, treatment, diagnosis or individual health field
deviations.why: Allowed scope only: health facility and professional regulation and aggregate statistics.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Health: no patient or clinical field anywhere, no national patient record; owner's direction 2026-10-21 §1

deviations.what: The seven minimisation answers per field (Part 1 §1.6) are not in the library contract: they are given with the procedure package the nation approves and recorded in the data and privacy review (a human publication gate)
deviations.why: Question 2 (the provision that authorises collection) is the nation's law; a library draft cannot answer it. No form is approved without the review.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md forms: publication is lib/forms/publication.ts (human approvals by different signed-in officials)

deviations.what: Each evidence item names its kind and when it is needed; the civicos.evidence-requirement.v1 record that ties it to a provision of law is made with the nation's procedure package
deviations.why: The legal basis of evidence is the nation's; until it is cited the evidence gate does not pass.

deviations.what: Scanning, OCR, USSD/SMS and offline field capture are not on the platform: a paper form is transcribed by an official and the case records that it came on paper and who transcribed it
